description: Experience the ultimate fusion of power, portability, and ruggedness with the Hammer Folding Electric Bike.

components.description: Provides instant responsiveness and increased stopping power, with less wear and tear to keep you safe in all riding conditions.

Easily install and remove the battery using the security key. The 48V 10.4 Ah Lithium-ion battery provides up to 40 miles range on a single charge. Full recharges in 2-3 hours using the included 3 Amp fast charger.
The LCD Smart Display features a speedometer, odometer, battery indicator, and backlighting. Easily switch from 5-level pedal assist, throttle, and traditional cycling mode.
The heart of the Hammer lies in the exceptional power and torque of the 500W motor, tackling the worst hill and toughest terrain, for an unrivaled riding experience.

Customize your ride with Shimano 7-speed gearing for quick and precise gear changes. Excel in any terrain with ease using more responsive torque.

The Hammer's wide, knobby fat tires are the key to conquering any terrain with ease. From sandy beaches to snowy trails, these high-traction tires grip the ground like a beast, providing stability and control in the most challenging environments. Whether you're navigating through muddy paths or gliding over rocky terrain, the Hammer's fat tires will keep you rolling with confidence.
4" wide tires provide the ultimate in stability, traction, and control, expanding your adventure to any terrain imaginable.
Ride comfortably anywhere. Featuring an adjustable handlebar stem and seatpost, tailor your fit to achieve custom comfort.
